author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ನೋವುಗಳ ಸಹಿಸುತಲೆ ಹೆತ್ತಿಹಳು
ತನ್ನತನ ಸರ್ವಸ್ವ ಧಾರೆಯೆರೆದಿಹಳು
ನಿನ್ನಭ್ಯುದಯವೆಲ್ಲ ತನ್ನಯೇಳಿಗೆಯೆನುವ
ನಿನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಮೇರು ಸಮ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Bearing all her pains, she gave birth to you;
she poured out her whole self for you;
she counts all your progress as her own rise;
your mother is equal to Mount Meru, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A mother endures pain to give us life, gives everything she has, and rejoices in our progress as her own. Her greatness is like the cosmic mountain Meru.
